packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-components
packages.description: Figure components: axes, legend, colorbar, annotations, shapes, hover labels, modebar.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-core
packages.description: Figure model, attribute schema system, validation, defaults, and update planning.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-express
packages.description: Plotly Express-style one-line charts from tabular data: grouping, facets, animation frames, ECDF, marginals.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart
packages.description: Holochart: declarative, GPU-rendered charts built on three.js (full bundle).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-locales
packages.description: Locale modules for Holochart (plotly.js's locales): UI strings, month and day names, number separators and date formats, one module per locale.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-render
packages.description: three.js rendering engine: renderer, viewports, GPU primitives, picking.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-runtime
packages.description: Chart runtime: createChart, pipeline orchestration, update API, events, and the trace-render / component contracts (ADR-019).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-themes
packages.description: Built-in templates, palettes, and colorscales.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-3d
packages.description: 3D scene subplot and 3D trace types: scatter3d, surface, mesh3d, cone, streamtube, volume, isosurface, bar3d.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-basic
packages.description: Basic trace types: scatter, bar, pie, table.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-finance
packages.description: Financial trace types: ohlc, candlestick, waterfall, funnel, funnelarea, indicator.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-geo
packages.description: Geographic trace types on map projections: the geo subplot, scattergeo.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-graph
packages.description: Network graph trace types: node-link graphs with force, layered and tree layouts, chord diagrams.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-hier
packages.description: Hierarchical and flow trace types: sunburst, treemap, icicle, sankey.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-sci
packages.description: Scientific trace types: heatmap, contour, image, scatterpolar, barpolar.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-traces-stats
packages.description: Statistical trace types: histogram, histogram2d, histogram2dcontour, box, violin.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-api-report
packages.description: API reports of the published packages (backlog S2.13): API Extractor over each built dist/index.d.ts, written to api-reports/.

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-geo-data
packages.description: Builds the basemap TopoJSON of @mk7s/holochart-traces-geo from Natural Earth (ADR-024).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-schema-gen
packages.description: Generates TS types, JSON schema, and attribute reference docs from the attribute schema (plan E1.2, E19.3).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-docs
packages.description: Documentation site for mk7s.dev/holochart (plan E19).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-sandbox
packages.description: Dev sandbox: hot-reloading example picker with GPU stats (plan E0.3).

packages.name: @mk7s/holochart-examples
packages.description: Canonical examples: docs embeds, gallery thumbnails, and visual regression tests (plan E19.2).
